sources.author: Rob Tuytel
sources.encoding: Original 16-bit PNG integer samples quantized to 8-bit RGB using round(value/257); alpha is removed only after every quantized alpha code is 255. Near-opaque source-alpha deviations are reported. WebP adds zero decoded-pixel error against the retained 8-bit reference. This is not 16-bit preservation.
